title: Introducing Lexi Track: Case Tracking and Practice Management for Indian Advocates
summary: Introducing Lexi Track, a case-tracking and practice-management platform for Indian advocates. Monitor hearings, orders, cause lists, and client matters in…
body_markdown:
We’re introducing **Lexi Track** , a case-tracking and litigation practice-management platform built for advocates and legal teams in India.


Track brings case monitoring, hearing schedules, cause lists, court updates, client records, and billing into one dashboard. It’s designed particularly for independent advocates and smaller litigation chambers that manage these responsibilities without dedicated administrative support.


Track joins our existing suite of legal AI tools for research, drafting, document review, and other workflows, bringing litigation practice management into the Lexi platform.


## Why case tracking remains a challenge for Indian advocates


For advocates handling litigation across multiple courts, staying informed about their matters often involves working across several systems.


An advocate might check one court portal for a hearing date, another for a newly uploaded order, and go through cause lists to see which matters are coming up. Meanwhile, client information, calendars, and billing are often maintained through spreadsheets, diaries, or other applications.


A single change in a hearing date can affect court appearances, preparation, and communication with clients.


For independent advocates and smaller chambers, where the same people often manage both legal work and administration, keeping these records updated can take up a significant part of the working day.


We built Lexi Track to make it easier for advocates to manage these responsibilities without constantly switching between different systems.


## What advocates can do with Lexi Track


### Track matters across Indian courts and tribunals


Advocates can add matters using a CNR, case number, party name, or advocate name.


Track supports case monitoring across the Supreme Court of India, High Courts, district courts, consumer commissions, NCLT, NCLAT, and other supported tribunals.


Once a matter is added, Track checks available court records for developments, including hearing-date changes, new orders, and case-history updates.


Instead of repeatedly checking individual portals, advocates can follow tracked matters from a central dashboard.


### Manage hearing schedules and cause lists


Track brings upcoming hearing dates and cause lists into one place, helping advocates see which matters are listed and what may require their attention.


Advocates can also add their Track hearing calendar to Google Calendar, Outlook, or Apple Calendar, so their upcoming hearings appear alongside their other commitments.


### Discover newly filed cases involving clients


With **Automatic Case Discovery** , advocates can save a party name and select a court they want to monitor.


Track checks daily for newly filed matching matters, helping advocates identify potential cases involving their clients without repeatedly searching court records.


This can be particularly useful for lawyers representing businesses, institutions, or clients involved in recurring litigation.


### Organise clients, matters, and billing


Beyond court monitoring, Track brings client records and invoicing into the same platform.


Advocates can organise their matters, maintain client information, and manage billing without relying on separate tools for each part of their practice.


## Why we built Track


In building Lexi, we've seen how much of a lawyer's working day goes into responsibilities beyond research, drafting, and advising clients.


For litigators, that includes monitoring court developments, keeping hearing schedules organised, and managing the administrative work surrounding active matters.


We've heard from advocates who spend part of every morning checking multiple court portals just to see whether anything has changed in their matters. That recurring problem helped shape how we approached Track.


A hearing-date change, a newly uploaded order, or an updated cause list may appear to be a small piece of information. For the advocate handling the matter, it can affect preparation, scheduling, and client communication.


We built Track to make those developments easier to follow, giving advocates a clearer view of their matters and more time to focus on what needs their attention.


## Lexi Track is now available


Lexi Track is now available to advocates and legal teams in India.


You can begin by adding your active matters and bringing court updates, hearing schedules, client records, and billing into one dashboard.


**One place for every matter.**


**Start tracking your matters today.**
